scripts.css: bun run aliases && bun run fonts && bun run engine && bun run view:demo && tailwindcss -i src/view/style.css -o src/view/index.css
scripts.css:watch: bun run css && tailwindcss -i src/view/style.css -o src/view/index.css --watch
scripts.dev: bun run css && bun run scripts/dev-hmr.ts
scripts.demo: bun run css && GITQUIET_DEMO=1 GITQUIET_INSPECT=50505 electrobun dev
scripts.dev:bundled: bun run css && GITQUIET_INSPECT=50505 electrobun dev
scripts.engine: bun run scripts/build-diff-engine.ts && bun run scripts/build-markdown-highlighter.ts && bun run scripts/build-markdown-mermaid.ts
